questions.stem: Which Microsoft web server on Windows Server hosts ASP.NET sites using modules you can add or remove?
questions.zhStem: 哪个 Windows Server 上的 Microsoft Web 服务器托管 ASP.NET 网站，并使用可增删的模块？
questions.definition: Internet Information Services (IIS) 7 and later provide a request-processing architecture which includes: ... A Web server engine that can be customized by adding or removing modules.
questions.zh: Internet Information Services（IIS）7 及更高版本提供一种请求处理架构，其中包括：……一个 Web 服务器引擎，可通过添加或删除模块对其进行自定义。

questions.stem: Which service hosts web apps without managing VMs, with Microsoft handling OS updates, load balancing and scaling?
questions.zhStem: 哪个服务托管 Web 应用而无需管理虚拟机，由 Microsoft 负责操作系统更新、负载均衡和扩缩？
questions.definition: Azure App Service is a fully managed platform for your web apps. You can use it to run and scale your web apps with minimal setup. Microsoft manages the infrastructure, operating system updates, load balancing, and scale-up/scale-down logic as needed.
questions.zh: Azure 应用服务是适用于 Web 应用的完全托管平台。你可以使用它以最少的设置运行和缩放 Web 应用。Microsoft 根据需要管理基础结构、操作系统更新、负载均衡以及纵向扩展/纵向缩减逻辑。

questions.stem: Which App Service feature adds instances when traffic passes a threshold, up to a set maximum?
questions.zhStem: 哪个 App Service 功能在流量超过阈值时增加实例，直到设定的上限？
questions.definition: The autoscale feature allows an administrator to set the maximum number of instances that the web app should be allowed to scale to, as well as the traffic thresholds.
questions.zh: 自动缩放功能允许管理员设置 Web 应用应允许缩放到的最大实例数，以及流量阈值。

questions.stem: Which App Service feature lets you test a new version in a live staging environment before production?
questions.zhStem: 哪个 App Service 功能让你在上线生产前，先在实时预发布环境中测试新版本？
questions.definition: Deployment slots allow operations or DevOps to deploy a new version of the web application to a live testing or staging environment, where manual or automated integration tests can be performed.
questions.zh: 部署槽位允许运维人员或 DevOps 将 Web 应用程序的新版本部署到实时测试或过渡环境，在其中可以执行手动或自动集成测试。

questions.stem: Which App Service tool asks a few guided questions and produces a report for the app's problem type?
questions.zhStem: 哪个 App Service 工具通过几个引导问题，生成针对应用问题类型的报告？
questions.definition: App Service diagnostics provide an interactive interface where the troubleshooter can answer a few questions. The interface produces a full diagnostic report that's specific to the type of problem that your application is encountering.
questions.zh: App Service 诊断提供交互式界面，故障排除人员可在其中回答几个问题。该界面会生成一份完整的诊断报告，专门针对应用程序所遇到的问题类型。

questions.stem: Which wizard-style tool checks an IIS web site for App Service compatibility and then moves it?
questions.zhStem: 哪个向导式工具检查 IIS 网站与 App Service 的兼容性，然后把它迁移过去？
questions.definition: The Azure App Service Migration Assistant is part of a larger suite of applications that help organizations with their transition to the cloud. The Migration Assistant provides a guided wizard-like user experience that performs two tasks:
questions.zh: Azure 应用服务迁移助手是一个更大的应用程序套件的一部分，这些应用程序可帮助组织向云过渡。迁移助手提供引导式的类向导用户体验，可执行以下两项任务：
keys: Azure 应用服务迁移助手
引导式的类向导用户体验

questions.stem: Which IIS setting keeps all web apps' configuration in one server-level file instead of separate web.config files?
questions.zhStem: 哪个 IIS 设置把所有 Web 应用的配置放在一个服务器级文件中，而不是各自的 web.config 文件？
questions.definition: Location tags allow you to keep configuration for all web apps hosted on a server in a single file rather than hosted in individual web.config files for each web app.
questions.zh: 位置标签让你可以将服务器上托管的所有 Web 应用的配置保存在单个文件中，而不是托管在每个 Web 应用各自的 web.config 文件中。

questions.stem: In IIS, which native component sees every request before the ASP.NET application handles it?
questions.zhStem: 在 IIS 中，哪个本机组件会在 ASP.NET 应用处理之前看到每个请求？
questions.definition: For example, some developers built features like monitoring, logging, and security on top of ISAPI filters. The filters provided access to incoming requests before they were passed to the ASP.NET application.
questions.zh: 例如，一些开发人员在 ISAPI 筛选器之上构建了监视、日志记录和安全等功能。这些筛选器可在传入请求传递给 ASP.NET 应用程序之前访问这些请求。

questions.stem: In App Service, what defines the compute resources, such as machine size and instance count, a web app runs on?
questions.zhStem: 在 App Service 中，什么定义了 Web 应用运行所用的计算资源，例如机器大小和实例数量？
questions.definition: An Azure App Service plan defines a set of compute resources for a web app to run.
questions.zh: Azure App Service 计划定义了一组计算资源，供 Web 应用运行。

questions.stem: Which App Service feature reaches an on-premises database when the network allows only outbound calls on port 443?
questions.zhStem: 当本地网络只允许通过 443 端口向外调用时，App Service 的哪项功能能访问本地数据库？
questions.definition: Within App Service, Hybrid Connections can be used to access application resources in any network that can make outbound calls to Azure over port 443.
questions.zh: 在 App Service 中，混合连接可用于访问任何能够通过端口 443 向 Azure 发起出站调用的网络中的应用程序资源。

questions.stem: Which on-premises component links an App Service web app through Service Bus Relay to an on-premises database?
questions.zhStem: 哪个本地组件通过 Service Bus Relay 把 App Service Web 应用连接到本地数据库？
questions.definition: Hybrid Connection Manager connects your web app running in Azure App Service to Azure Service Bus Relay to facilitate a connection with your on-premises database endpoint.
questions.zh: 混合连接管理器将在 Azure App Service 中运行的 Web 应用连接到 Azure Service Bus Relay，以便与本地数据库终结点建立连接。
